name: Tumors
summary: In Darnassus, the Cenarion Circle seeks to contain the sickness spreading through Teldrassil. You are sent to Wellspring Lake to gather mossy tumors from afflicted timberlings, so druids can study the poison and burn the growths safely.

sections.title: Blight upon the Timberlings
sections.body: Teldrassil’s native plants and animals are being twisted by a strange affliction. Its timberlings, usually placid nature spirits with bark for skin, have grown hostile and erratic. Grotesque mossy tumors spread across their living wood, pulsing with unnatural poison. Cenarion scholars Denalan and Rellian Greenspyre search for the cause, while timberlings already lost to the sickness must be culled to protect the rest of the boughs.

sections.title: Containment at Wellspring Lake
sections.body: Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil has become a focal point of the outbreak, and its timberlings are among the most tainted on the World Tree. Rellian Greenspyre asks you to kill these corrupted guardians and cut away their tumors. Bring the growths to the druids in Darnassus, where they can be burned safely. The night elves hope this will slow the contagion while they search for the disease’s source.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings growing tumors?
faq.answer: A mysterious sickness has taken root in Teldrassil’s wild spirits. The tumors are outward signs of a toxic taint coursing through the timberlings, twisting their natural protective instincts into blind aggression.

Rellian Greenspyre is a night elf researcher of the Cenarion Circle, stationed in Darnassus. He works with botanists such as Denalan to study the strange corruptions affecting Teldrassil’s living things.

faq.q: Why must the tumors be burned?
faq.answer: The tumors are filled with poison that must be cleansed from Teldrassil. Rellian Greenspyre asks you to bring him the growths so they can be burned.
Wellspring Lake lies in northern Teldrassil, fed by the bough’s pristine waterways. The timberlings along its shores are more diseased than those found elsewhere.

faq.q: Can the timberlings be cured instead of killed?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle searches for a cure or the blight’s origin, but the timberlings wandering Wellspring Lake are already beyond help. Until the source is found, killing the most aggressive spirits is the only way to safeguard the forest.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the tumors to Darnassus?
faq.answer: After Rellian secures and destroys the tumors, he directs you back to field botanist Denalan near Lake Al’Ameth to continue investigating the corruption spreading through Teldrassil’s flora.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you face the tragic but necessary duty of destroying corrupted nature spirits to protect Teldrassil’s fragile balance from total collapse.
As a night elf, you see disease appear rapidly in the newly grown World Tree, an alarming sign that challenges Fandral Staghelm’s promise of an untouched haven.
As an herbalist, you may be unsettled to see living wood and moss warp into venomous, malignant tumors instead of healthy foliage. Botanists face the same sight.
